# <type>(optional-scope): <short imperative summary>
#
# Allowed types:
# feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, ci, chore
#
# Examples:
# feat(bathy): add refraction-aware color loss
# fix(process-data): cast point error to float
# ci: skip unrelated process-data tests on bathy branches
#
# Optional details below the summary line.
